name: sheet-sides
title: Sheet sides
description: A sheet from each edge: top, end, bottom and start.

files.content:
import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { Button } from '@/ui/button/button'; import { Sheet, SheetClose, SheetContent, SheetDescription, SheetHeader, SheetOverlay, SheetPortal, SheetTitle, SheetTrigger, type SheetSide, } from '@/ui/sheet/sheet'; /** * A sheet from each edge. `start` and `end` are logical, so they swap in * right-to-left layouts. */ @Component({ selector: 'example-sheet-sides', imports: [ Button, Sheet, SheetClose, SheetContent, SheetDescription, SheetHeader, SheetOverlay, SheetPortal, SheetTitle, SheetTrigger, ], template: `
@for (side of sides; track side) {

{{ side }} sheet

It slides in from the {{ side }}.

 }
`, }) export class SheetSidesExample { protected readonly sides: readonly SheetSide[] = [ 'top', 'end', 'bottom', 'start', ]; }
